cohort: The cohort consists of 2,934 births conceived using medically assisted reproduction in Louisiana between 2016 and 2023, categorized by parental structure.
finding: Birthing people in same-sex relationships experienced higher risks of labor induction and lower risks of cesarean delivery, while single-parent households exhibited higher risks of gestational hypertension.
mod_finding: Birthing people in same-sex relationships had higher risks of labor induction and lower risks of cesarean delivery compared to those in different-sex relationships.
